{{Quote|Look at him squirm!|The officer|<ref name="Secret weapon" />}}
An individual served as an '''officer''' in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|navy]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Secret weapon" /> Around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]],<ref name="Dates">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The Last of the Jedi: Secret Weapon]]'' to around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]].</ref> they were one of the lesser [[Officer/Legends|officers]] on the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of an Imperial [[Unidentified Imperial starship (Bellassa)|starship]] that encountered two [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter|V-wing starfighters]] [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by [[the Eleven]] resistance group members [[Naima]] and [[Terris]] while approaching the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bellassa/Legends|Bellassa's]] inner [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]. After the Imperial [[Starship/Legends|starship]] destroyed one of the [[Starfighter/Legends|V-wings]], the officer commented on how the remaining V-wing squirmed as it attempted to avoid the ship's [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]]. In response to their comment,<ref name="Secret weapon" /> the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]]<ref name="Companion">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] looked at them, and the officer paled. Following the destruction of the second V-wing, Vader spoke to the vessel's [[Unidentified Imperial captain (Bellassa)|captain]] in a low voice, telling them that emotion had no place on a starship bridge and to reassign the officer to the nearest [[Prison/Legends|penal colony]] when they reached Bellassa.<ref name="Secret weapon" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial officer appeared in ''[[The Last of the Jedi: Secret Weapon]]'', a [[2007]] junior novel written by [[Jude Watson]] as the seventh installment in the ''[[Star Wars: The Last of the Jedi]]'' series.<ref name="Secret weapon" />
